intro: Our Sumo recliner lets you unwind in style. It blends soft, supportive comfort with easy functionality—your perfect partner for movie nights, naps, or just taking it easy.

features.title: Recline, effortlessly
features.text: The easy-glide reclining mechanism lets you lean back with a simple push—smooth, quiet, and oh-so-satisfying.

features.title: Sink into softness
features.text: High-density foam cushions cradle your body, offering that sinking-in comfort you’ll never want to get out of.

features.title: Gentle lumbar hug
features.text: Premium foam and soft fiber fill in the lumbar area give you just the right support for long, lazy lounging.

features.title: Cool to the touch
features.text: Durable microfiber upholstery is soft, breathable, and built to handle daily use with ease and elegance.

features.title: Armrests made to relax into
features.text: Broad and angular, the padded armrests offer natural positioning for your arms—making it easier to sink in and stay put, especially during those long, lazy evenings.

features.title: Comfort in every curve
features.text: Ergonomically shaped to support your entire body—from head to toe, this recliner makes every seat the best one.

name: Sumo V2 1-Seater Fab Leather Manual Recliner
